_comment: Mutation testing for the relationship graph on the entity detail pages (components/graph + hooks/useRelationGraph). WHY: the model decides which objects are on the canvas and how they connect. A dedup that keys on the wrong thing draws a second copy of an object instead of a cycle; a collapse that prunes by ownership instead of reachability leaves orphans or removes nodes another open node still holds; a wrong edge direction or label merge says the opposite relation; a cluster threshold off by one hides or floods objects. None of that is visible as an error. SCOPE: the pure modules (model, reducer, layout, neighbour adapter, drawing decisions) and the hook are mutated; the presentational SVG and the panel are excluded with reasons. MUTATOR SET: StringLiteral and ObjectLiteral disabled, matching the sibling UI configs (labels are pinned by explicit assertions instead). NOT YET MEASURED: break is absent until a first run measures a score. Run: cd app/ui && npm run test:mutation:graph

mutationExclusions.src/components/graph/RelationGraph.jsx: Presentational SVG: draws the nodes, edges and labels at the positions graphLayout.js computes, with classes and labels from graphDraw.js (both mutated), and wires pointer/keyboard input to useGraphPointer and useRelationGraph (mutated). RelationGraph.mount.test.jsx asserts the drawn nodes, edge labels, keyboard and drag behaviour.
Card composition only: the graph, a Collapse all button and the ExpandedItemsList fed from the hook state; no decisions of its own. Covered by RelationGraph.mount.test.jsx and the detail page mount tests.
